title: esym.Optimize: simplification and merging of duplicates of symbolic expressions, and optimize in CreateSymbolicUserFunction
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.49.2 (maintainer 2026-10-25: as recommended in symbolicFlatProgramOptimization.md): esym.Optimize(expressions, level=1, mergeDuplicates=True) builds a new graph in one pass from the leaves up; duplicates merged by class and new operands, leaves included; level 1 exact rules, level 2 the rules that lose a nan or change the rounding; CreateSymbolicUserFunction(..., optimize=True) with these defaults.
releaseNotes: exudyn.symbolic.Optimize(expressions, level=1, mergeDuplicates=True) builds new symbolic expressions in which equal subexpressions and leaves are one node and 1*x, x+0, x**0 and operations of numbers are removed, with the same results; level=2 also removes 0*x, x-x, x/x and combines numbers. CreateSymbolicUserFunction applies it by default (optimize=True).
